name: 21212 · Baltimore, MD
findings: ZIP 21212 (Baltimore) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 75 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21212 (Baltimore) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21212 (Baltimore) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
